需求层审核说明

Shadowsocks HarmonyOS 5.4.0 Android parity · 需求层决策说明

The Android mobile app at v5.3.5-nightly is the parity target. Review the scope, the journey set and the acceptance bar.

e123804+dirty 状态：待你判断 人读页面禁止展示判据
与上次审核的差异

首次审核。

硬限制

人读页面禁止展示判据。判据只给机器检查与追溯。审核材料只给问题、图、选项和后果。

这次要你判断什么

4 个决策。推荐项排第一。

1 Is the Android v5.3.5-nightly mobile app the correct parity target?P0
2 Should the 56 Android-only cases stay out of the HarmonyOS port?P0
3 Do the 11 unit journeys match how a phone user works?P1
4 Is the 348-case set the right acceptance bar for 5.4.0?P1

验收例子（第 1/80 张）

规则情况结果类型
The service button shows the stopped icon for Idle and Stopped, connecting for Connecting, connected for Connected, stopping for Stopping.给定the service state is Connected，当the state change is appliedthe button shows the connected icon正例
The service button shows the stopped icon for Idle and Stopped, connecting for Connecting, connected for Connected, stopping for Stopping.给定the service state is Idle at activity start，当the activity resets the UI before bindingthe button shows the stopped icon, replacing the layout's idle drawable边界
A tap on the service button stops the service when state.canStop is true and starts it otherwise.给定the service state is Connected，当the user taps the service buttonthe app broadcasts the CLOSE action and the service begins stopping正例
A tap on the service button stops the service when state.canStop is true and starts it otherwise.给定the service state is Stopped，当the user taps the service buttonthe app runs the StartService contract instead of stopping反例
The service button is enabled only when the state can stop or the state is Stopped. On API 24 and later the pointer icon is a hand when the button is enabled and a wait icon when it is disabled.给定the state is Connected and the device runs API 24 or later，当the button state is appliedthe button is enabled and its pointer icon is a hand正例
The service button is enabled only when the state can stop or the state is Stopped. On API 24 and later the pointer icon is a hand when the button is enabled and a wait icon when it is disabled.给定the state is Stopped and the device runs API 23，当the button state is appliedthe button is enabled and the pointer icon stays at the platform default, because the code sets no pointer icon below API 24边界
The service button is enabled only when the state can stop or the state is Stopped. On API 24 and later the pointer icon is a hand when the button is enabled and a wait icon when it is disabled.给定the state is Idle and the device runs API 24 or later，当the activity has not yet bound to the servicethe button is disabled and its pointer icon is a wait icon反例
The service button is enabled only when the state can stop or the state is Stopped. On API 24 and later the pointer icon is a hand when the button is enabled and a wait icon when it is disabled.给定the state is Stopping，当the button state is appliedthe button is disabled, so a second stop cannot be requested边界
The service button is checked, and therefore drawn with the green background, only when the state is Connected.给定the state becomes Connected，当the drawable state is refreshedstate_checked is merged and the background uses material_green_700正例
The service button is checked, and therefore drawn with the green background, only when the state is Connected.给定the state becomes Connecting，当the drawable state is refreshedstate_checked is absent and the background uses material_primary_500反例
The service button content description and tooltip read Stop when the state can stop, and Connect otherwise.给定the state is Connected，当the state change is appliedthe content description and tooltip read Stop正例
The service button content description and tooltip read Stop when the state can stop, and Connect otherwise.给定the state is Stopped，当the state change is appliedthe content description and tooltip read Connect反例

验收例子（第 2/80 张）

规则情况结果类型
In Connecting the progress ring shows as indeterminate after the medium animation time plus one second, once the activity is started. The delay runs first and does not pause. 要你核对的假设

需求里没写、补上去的前提。图上用虚线框和「假设」二字标出。只有你能判断它在现实里成不成立。

假设 A1 The pinned Android baseline is the intended parity target.

依据：The user named the Android version in the same repository tree.

不成立时：A later Android change is out of scope until a new baseline is set.

出现在：流程：Port the parity requirement to HarmonyOS

假设 A2 Android-only surfaces stay Android-only unless HarmonyOS exposes an equivalent system API.

依据：The public HarmonyOS SDK does not expose every Android platform surface.

不成立时：Some cases become platform decisions instead of implementation work.

出现在：范围：Shadowsocks HarmonyOS 5.4.0 Android parity管什么，外面有谁

假设 A3 A control that is visible but disabled still counts as a control.

依据：The parity target is the visible UI, not only the active paths.

不成立时：Disabled controls stay in the tree and in the case set.

出现在：流程：Main shell, navigation drawer, connect control, stats bar

决策卡

每个决策选一个选项。要改就选「这个决策要改」，并写原因。

决策 1 · Is the Android v5.3.5-nightly mobile app the correct parity target?

原因：The reversed requirements, the control tree and the 348 cases come from this baseline.

决策 2 · Should the 56 Android-only cases stay out of the HarmonyOS port?

原因：Some surfaces depend on Android platform APIs that the public HarmonyOS SDK does not expose.

决策 3 · Do the 11 unit journeys match how a phone user works?

原因：Each journey drives one unit of implementation and its E2E cases.

决策 4 · Is the 348-case set the right acceptance bar for 5.4.0?

原因：Every requirement item has at least one case, and every case has a parity tag.
